video.title: AI Pipeline Explained! How Ai pipeline works? #ai

transcript.text: What is AI pipeline and how does it
work? Just like how CICD pipeline turns
code into a deployed application in
DevOps, an AI pipeline is a process that
turns raw data into a working AI feature
in production. So, here's how it works.
It starts with data collection where
data is gathered from different sources
like databases, APIs, or logs. This data
is then cleaned and prepared so the
model can learn from it properly. Next,
an AI model is trained on this data to
learn patterns or make predictions.
After training, the model is evaluated
using metrics like accuracy and
precision to make sure it performs well.
If it passes the accuracy threshold, the
model is then deployed into production
to make predictions. After deployment,
monitoring will track the performance of
your model detecting issues like
performance drop or data drift. In
short, this feedback of the AI pipeline
is super important to retrain or improve
the model over time making the pipeline
continuous just like CICD pipeline.
